summary: Iteration 19 tested settings (music, sound, kg/lb, cm/in), peer movement (onLand and smoothness), building sprites (see-through holes and checkerboard), map audits, modal corners, SEO and favicon, and ran the duel no-reward regression. Almost everything passes. One sprite still has the checkerboard: charter_boat (used on the sunken and harrow maps). The pennant string on the Crew HQ (guild_hall) now has a white filled wedge. One minor bug in the inch formatter.

minor.issue: Preflight reflects any Origin (https://evil.com) and sends allow-credentials: true. Auth uses a Bearer token in localStorage, so the risk is low. Still, allow only explicit origins.

ui_bugs.issue: For lengths just under a whole foot, ft/in formatting rounds the leftover inches up to 12. Example: 121.5 cm -> '3 ft 12 in' instead of '4 ft 0 in'. Fix: total = Math.round(c / 2.54); ft = Math.floor(total / 12); in = total % 12.

design_issues.screen: Biome maps sunken (2 boats) and harrow (1 boat): charter_boat.webp
issues: A grey/white 'transparent mockup' checkerboard is still baked in as opaque pixels. It shows on the bow rail panel (about x 650-900, y 230-300 of the sprite) and in the flybridge tower/windshield area. solid_buildings.py only treats pixels with saturation < 16 and mean > 150 as checkerboard. These darker grey squares (~100-170) are kept, so the checker stays.

The area between the flag and the A-B-C-D pennant string is now filled solid white, which makes a white sail-like wedge under the pennants. The sil & ~bgish fill closed this open-air gap. It should be transparent, or the pennants recut.
mapcheck reports onPath: bush@900,1300 (a bush placed on the path). Minor.

passed: Landing: document.title 'FishyLand · Free Online Fishing MMO in Your Browser'. The meta description mentions the free online fishing MMO. og:image /art/og.jpg returns 200. JSON-LD @type VideoGame is present.
favicon.ico (48x48), favicon-32.png, fav-192.png and apple-touch-icon.png (180) all return 200. fav-192 shows the Harbourmaster (captain with white beard, gold ring).

Settings modal: menu-more -> more-settings opens settings-modal. All 8 set-* buttons toggle aria-pressed. Choices persist after reload (fr_settings music/sound false; owo_prefs weight_unit lb, length_unit in). Esc closes the modal.
Music Off pauses the HTMLAudio track (millbrook.mp3 paused=true) and On resumes it (paused=false).
Inventory in lb: 14 cards show weights in lb and none in kg.
Catch popup in lb/in: catch-length '6.2 in', catch-weight '0.110 lb', tape end '6"'. In kg/cm: '30 cm', '0.352 kg', tape end '30'. Keep, Fishdex and Sell buttons are present. Sell closes the popup.

Peers: harbour 1550,2080 -> 2800,1665 and millbrook 800,1230 -> 2150,1100 stay onLand=true for every sample (44 and 97 samples). Replaying a route with 600ms posts gave no stalls (no 100ms sample without movement). The millbrook trace advanced steadily.

Sprite audit: tavern (Anchor Cafe) windows are solid. Its only enclosed transparent regions are the open-air deck ends between the light poles, which is fine. house, guild_hall glass, swamp_shack, coast_hut, stilt_hut and the other biome huts have no holes and no checkerboard. The fountain hole (inside the water arc) and the ship rail holes are real open air.
Map audits: harbour has no dropped or onPath objects (only 3 rocks auto-moved). saltmarsh, blackwater, coral, greyfell, sunken, harrow, willow, frozen, ghostlight, temple and cinder are all clean.
Tackle Shop modal: all 4 corner brackets meet the frame cleanly, with no notch or gap.
Duel regression test_iter18_duel_no_rewards.py: 3/3 passed (duel catch gives no xp/gold/inventory/journal; duel score counts; winner gets no gold; normal catch after the duel is regular).
Auth: password_hash starts with $2b$12$ and login lockout logic exists (429 after repeated failures).
action_items: Re-cut charter_boat.webp to remove the baked grey/white checkerboard (bow rail panel and tower area). For example, detect alternating grey blocks of any brightness, or use the raw source.
Make the white wedge between the Crew HQ flag and the pennant string transparent again (guild_hall.webp).
Fix ln() inch rounding so it never shows '12 in' (round total inches first).
Optional: move the millbrook bush at 900,1300 off the path. Restrict CORS origins.
critical_code_review_comments: solid_buildings.py: bgish = sat<16 & mean>150 leaves large enclosed bg regions (>0.6%) transparent and misses darker checker squares, so charter_boat keeps its checker.

Scene.js peers: the path is recomputed from the current position on every new target. Movement uses dt clamped to 0.05, so peers slow down at low FPS (headless runs at 2 fps). This is expected in real browsers.
GameSettings.js: length falls back to lengthUnit() (lb implies in), which is fine. Defaults follow the locale: en-US guests start on lb/in.
seed_data_creation: Caught 2 fish as TestAngler (both sold). One duel was played between TestAngler and TestAngler2 by the regression test, and both left afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Headless Chromium runs at about 2 FPS, so peer movement looks slow; check onLand and continuity rather than speed. For the sprite checks, run python3 /app/tests/sprite_audit.py (enclosed holes plus grey/checker stats) and /app/tests/checker_crops.py (crops on magenta). For catch popups, use the iter16 approach: fr_mode=water, __fx.me=1506,1047, Space, route /api/fish/land success=true. To set units, set owo_prefs weight_unit/length_unit or use the settings modal.
